patch_scope: Checker-only. Includes overlay 072 path classification repair and adds an independent FP64 full inertia-chain derivative gate. No production kernels, solver tolerances, source material law, or native inputs change.

inertia_chain.native_source: actual fixture MRBodyStateGPU FP32 words: orientation, angularVelocity, timestep, source world inverse-inertia rows; candidate deltaOmega and each test direction are also canonicalized to exact FP32 then promoted to FP64
inertia_chain.equations: q=Exp(dt*(omega0+DeltaOmega))*q0; Iinv(q)=R(Exp(phi))*Iinv0_world*R^T; R=-I(q)*DeltaOmega; A=-dR; dtheta=dt*J_left(phi)*dDeltaOmega; dI=[dtheta]x I-I[dtheta]x
inertia_chain.native_FP32_candidate_FD: retained as independent quantization-sensitive diagnostic; unresolved remains INCONCLUSIVE and is not upgraded by the FP64 gate
inertia_chain.source_bound_values: emitted as raw IEEE-754 FP32 bit words in inertia_chain_binding line; derived from the checker fixture at execution, not copied from a separate illustrative case

path_classification.repair: sampled FP64 path oracle is restored; raw status and sampled gaps print before suite classification; positive sampled gap is not described as swept-clear certification; remaining checks continue after an angular-path failure

validation.native: PENDING root-controlled; no GPU run performed by overlay author
